_meta.purpose: Controlled relation vocabulary for atomic scientific assertions.
_meta.rule: Choose the narrowest applicable relation. If none fits, use other and state the exact relation in assertion.relation_detail.
_meta.direction_rule: subject -> relation -> object. Do not reverse causal or comparative direction.

increases.definition: The subject raises the value, rate, probability or level of the object under stated conditions.

decreases.definition: The subject lowers the value, rate, probability or level of the object under stated conditions.

no_change.definition: The subject has no reported or detected change in the object within the tested conditions.

associates_with.definition: A statistical or observed association is reported without sufficient evidence for causation.

causes.definition: The source provides evidence that the subject produces the object as a causal effect.

enables.definition: The subject makes the object possible, feasible or operational.

inhibits.definition: The subject reduces the activity, growth or function of the object.

predicts.definition: The subject forecasts or is statistically predictive of the object.

outperforms.definition: The subject performs better than the object on a stated metric and comparison.

equivalent_to.definition: The subject and object are reported as statistically or operationally equivalent under stated criteria.

measured_as.definition: The assertion reports a measured value, property or estimated quantity.

observed_in.definition: The subject is observed in the stated population, sample, material or setting.

requires.definition: The object is a reported prerequisite or dependency of the subject.

produces.definition: The subject yields or generates the object.

uses_method.definition: The subject uses the object as a method, instrument or protocol.

validates.definition: The subject is used to validate the object, or the object validates the subject.

contradicts.definition: The subject is reported to conflict with the object.

limited_to.definition: The assertion's conclusion is explicitly restricted to the stated object, condition or population.

not_reported.definition: The source does not report the requested quantity or relation; this is an evidence-boundary assertion.

uncertain.definition: The source is insufficient, ambiguous or conflicting, so the requested relation cannot be determined.

other.definition: Use only when the relation is scientific but outside this vocabulary; provide assertion.relation_detail.
